title: Explicit identity and credential lifecycle
description: Use isolated service and node identities to prove authentication, retirement, startup, transfer and browser login. Requires an agent-owned Chrome CDP port in FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT. No human credentials or live farm changes.

protocol.intent: Environment values create no identity; only issued credentials authenticate and retirement keeps admin protection.

startup.intent: Explicit credentials start the gateway and node, survive node rotation and restart, transfer files, and authenticate the browser through its real login form.
